units.source_text: 迁居既毕，薰大将在本邸中从容细看二公主，但见她的容姿非常可爱。

en.t: After the move was complete, Captain Kaoru calmly looked over the Second Princess at his main residence and found her appearance utterly charming.

units.source_text: 身材小巧，态度高尚优雅，毫无缺陷。

en.t: She was small and delicate in figure, noble and graceful in manner, and without the slightest flaw.

units.source_text: 他觉得自己命运不坏，心中颇感骄矜，希望因此而忘记了已故的宇治大女公子。

en.t: He felt that his own fate was not so bad after all, and with a certain pride in his heart, he hoped this would let him forget the late elder lady of Uji.

units.source_text: 然而终于不能忘记，还是时刻恋慕。

en.t: Yet in the end he could not forget her and still longed for her at every moment.

units.source_text: 他想：“这相思之苦在现世恐怕无法慰藉了。

en.t: He thought, "This suffering of love can probably never be comforted in this present world.

units.source_text: 直须等到我死去成佛之后，明白了这段异常痛苦的因缘是何种恶业的果报，方始可以忘怀吧。”

en.t: Only after I die and become a Buddha, when I understand what evil karma has brought about this unusually painful bond, will I finally be able to forget it."

units.source_text: 他专心料理宇治山庄改造佛寺的工事。

en.t: He devoted himself to managing the work of converting the Uji villa into a Buddhist temple.
